recipes.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has "{2}{R}: Target creature can't block this creature this turn."

recipe_coverage: Reviewed continuous Aura component: normal casting and target loss, persistence through cleanup, legal Disenchant removal and Disperse bounce, attached-host bounce/destruction, owner-specific zones, exact costs, snapshot/AI replay, and declared keywords through real combat. Declared entry draw/life effects and Aura-to-hand death replacements are checked. Activated abilities, alternate costs, graveyard return abilities, dredge, madness, cycling, aura swap, and granted activated abilities remain separate coverage gaps where present. Not whole-card certification. Fearsome Temper currently requests its cast target twice through two Aura helpers. The same intended host is supplied for both prompts; this presentation defect is not covered by the continuous-effect assertions.
